# `hyperstac-model`

Tile normalized IMC images, train HyPERSTAC VICReg, and extract patch representations

- Wrapper: [`job_hyperstac_model.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_hyperstac_model.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-hyperstac`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.hyperstac_model`

## Inputs

- hyperstac.asset_folder/normalised_images or configured source ROI/channel TIFFs

## Outputs

- hyperstac.asset_folder patches, model weights, metadata, and representation/metric AnnData

## Configuration

- general, hyperstac, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl hyperstac-model
```
